notes: Stop actually stops -- 1.0.8.8's Stop button set a flag and did nothing else. It now cancels the supply queue (the old !abort aimed at the guild bank's queue, which supply sends never use). A stuck bank is replaced from a ranked reserve after three minutes. Each supplier row shows which order it is filling. A send waits for a free march slot. Order tails go out at a million or not at all. A customer who leaves the guild ends the order. Carts already dispatched still cannot be recalled.
